0022600136.text: The Orlando Magic (1-2, 10th in the East) visit the Toronto Raptors (2-1, 4th in the East) with Orlando 0-2 at home and 1-0 on the road, while Toronto is 1-0 at home and 1-1 on the road. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), with Kawhi Leonard listed as day-to-day with knee inflammation and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Magic lost the season series 1-2, including a 139-87 loss in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
